key_insight: For S355J2C+N V-groove butt joints welded by GMAW, a 2 mm root gap with 18 V gave the best overall weld quality among the tested settings.
engineering_relevance: The study suggests a practical parameter window for improving root penetration quality and reducing weld defects in GMAW fabrication, even though the tested factor effects were not statistically significant.
method: Tested 2 root gaps: 2 mm and 3 mm
Tested 3 voltages: 17 V, 18 V, and 19 V; assessed welds with VT and PT
evidence_signal: Fisher Exact Test showed no significant relationship between root gap or voltage and VT/PT outcomes (p > 0.05), but the 2 mm + 18 V condition had the fewest defects, with no VT discontinuities and one acceptable PT porosity indication.
watch_item: Because only two root gaps and three voltages were evaluated, the preferred setting should be validated across broader parameter ranges and more specimens before general use.
paper_title: Analysis of the Effect of Root Gap and Welding Voltage Variations on Weld Defects in GMAW Penetration
